turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My neck hurts every morning, so I'm shopping for a new pillow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a contoured memory foam pillow with a dip in the middle for your head.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a classic feather pillow, soft and squishy, that you can punch into shape.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A buckwheat pillow full of little husks, which apparently stays cool and supports well but rustles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For neck pain, the contoured foam is often the most supportive. Feathers are comfy but flatten during the night, and buckwheat is a great middle ground if the rustling doesn't bother you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, Got a horrible calf cramp at three this morning. I yelled so loud I woke the dog.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ouch. When it happens, flex your foot toward your knee, it stretches the muscle and usually eases it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Common triggers are dehydration, a long day on your feet, or a lot of exercise. Sometimes there's no clear reason.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's likely it. A gentle calf stretch before bed and a glass of water can help prevent the next one.
